mapper.select: SELECT ms.id, ms.medical_user_id, u.real_name, ms.schedule_date, ms.shift_type, ms.start_time, ms.end_time, ms.status, ms.remark, ms.room_id, r.room_number FROM medical_schedule ms LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON ms.medical_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN room r ON ms.room_id = r.id WHERE ms.deleted = 0 ORDER BY ms.schedule_date DESC, ms.start_time ASC

SELECT ms.id, ms.medical_user_id, u.real_name, ms.schedule_date, ms.shift_type, ms.start_time, ms.end_time, ms.status, ms.remark, ms.room_id, r.room_number FROM medical_schedule ms LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON ms.medical_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN room r ON ms.room_id = r.id WHERE ms.deleted = 0 AND ms.medical_user_id = #{medicalUserId} ORDER BY ms.schedule_date DESC, ms.start_time ASC

SELECT ms.id, ms.medical_user_id, u.real_name, ms.schedule_date, ms.shift_type, ms.start_time, ms.end_time, ms.status, ms.remark, ms.room_id, r.room_number FROM medical_schedule ms LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON ms.medical_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN room r ON ms.room_id = r.id WHERE ms.deleted = 0 AND ms.schedule_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY ms.schedule_date ASC, ms.start_time ASC

SELECT ms.id, ms.medical_user_id, u.real_name, ms.schedule_date, ms.shift_type, ms.start_time, ms.end_time, ms.status, ms.remark, ms.room_id, r.room_number FROM medical_schedule ms LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON ms.medical_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN room r ON ms.room_id = r.id WHERE ms.deleted = 0 AND ms.medical_user_id = #{medicalUserId} AND ms.schedule_date = #{date} ORDER BY ms.start_time ASC
